header.source: Retained runs.sqlite3 public events; count-slime-actions.py, no new episodes.

definitions.route_steps: deterministic skill decisions carrying slime-mold FoodEvidence and a path
definitions.acquisition_actions: food-intent actions that visibly increase canonical slime inventory units
definitions.acquired_units: sum of those positive canonical inventory-unit deltas
definitions.inventory_meal_answers: accepted canonical slime item letters at the exact EAT item prompt
definitions.floor_meal_answers: yes answers to an exact canonical slime floor EAT offer
definitions.completed_inventory_units: visible canonical inventory-unit loss on a slime item-answer action

header.unit_caveat: Acquired units are positive inventory-unit deltas, including recovery of previously stolen food, not necessarily distinct generated items. Meal units are observed consumption, not a claim of 250 effective nutrition each; rotten meals occurred.
header.row_coverage: Only episodes with canonical-slime FoodEvidence; all baseline counts are explicitly zero in arm_counts.
